args: exe=$(command -v google-chrome-stable || command -v chromium || true); exec npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@1.12.0 --headless --isolated --no-usage-statistics --no-performance-crux --allowedUrlPattern='http://localhost:*/*' --allowedUrlPattern='http://127.0.0.1:*/*' ${exe:+--executablePath="$exe"}
chrome-devtools.description: Visual QA for the portfolio's LOCAL build only: headless isolated Chrome (temp profile, no credentials) restricted by --allowedUrlPattern to http://localhost:* and http://127.0.0.1:* (`pnpm dev` → http://localhost:3000). Screenshots, a11y/DOM snapshots, computed styles, console, perf traces. Telemetry and CrUX off. Public/production pages go through the server browser fleet, not this server.
